# pykbroker

> Apache-2.0 Python SDK and read-only-by-default MCP server for Korean broker Open APIs.

한국어 기본 문서와 영어 번역 / Korean documentation with English translations.
KIS, DBFI and Toss are implemented adapters with offline mock/fixture validation only.
Real APIs, paper accounts and live trading have not been validated. LS is registered
with default-locked writes and UNVERIFIED candidate fill fields; Kiwoom is registered; experimental NH/KB
adapters remain outside the factory. See the broker support matrix.
Dry-run blocks order/cancellation transmission; it does not simulate successful orders.
Vendor source SDKs and authentication must be supplied separately.
The execution SDK contains contracts only, without an execution engine.
Canonical URLs below are planned publication targets; public availability is unverified.
These files do not publish the site or guarantee crawling or AI citations.

[Source repository](https://github.com/STOA-company/pykbroker)

[Full documentation text](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/llms-full.txt)

## Documentation

- [Adding a broker adapter](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/BROKER_ADAPTER_RECIPE/): 한국 증권사 어댑터 추가 절차: 공식 응답 증거, 클라이언트 주입, 주문 안전 게이트와 오프라인 테스트.
- [Broker support matrix](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/BROKER_MATRIX/): KIS·DBFI·Toss의 오프라인 검증 범위와 LS 기본 잠금과 키움·NH·KB experimental 상태, KR·US 시장과 취소 제약.
- [Brokers](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/api/brokers/): KIS·DBFI·Toss와 create_broker의 조회·주문 계약, 인스턴스 수명과 experimental 어댑터 제한.
- [Models](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/api/models/): pykbroker의 불변 Pydantic 모델: 잔고·시세·주문·취소·거래 규칙 필드와 Decimal·미확인 값 처리.
- [Korean cash-equity rules](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/api/rules/): KRX 현물 주식 기본 호가 단위와 정규장 규칙 도우미, 거래일 콜백과 미지원 상품 범위.
- [Changelog](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/changelog/): pykbroker 0.1.0 미출시 변경 기록: 증권사 어댑터, 안전 부품, MCP·CLI와 미완료 검증 범위.
- [클로드 데스크톱에 한국 증권사 MCP 서버 연결하기](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/claude-desktop/): 클로드 데스크톱에 pykbroker-mcp를 연결하는 JSON 설정, 인증 환경 주입, 읽기 전용 도구 확인과 오류 점검.
- [CLI](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/cli/): pykbroker CLI로 시세·잔고·보유 종목·주문 상태·규칙을 조회하는 명령과 오류 종료 코드.
- [Contributing](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/contributing/): pykbroker 기여 절차, 안전 변경 리뷰, 오프라인 테스트와 어댑터 문서·라이선스 갱신 기준.
- [Adding a broker adapter](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/en/BROKER_ADAPTER_RECIPE/): Add a Korean broker adapter with documented response evidence, client injection, order safety gates and offline tests.
- [Broker support matrix](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/en/BROKER_MATRIX/): Offline verification scope for KIS, DBFI and Toss, locked LS and experimental Kiwoom/NH/KB status, KR/US markets and cancellation limits.
- [Brokers](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/en/api/brokers/): Query and order contracts for KIS, DBFI, Toss and create_broker, instance lifetimes and experimental adapter restrictions.
- [Models](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/en/api/models/): Immutable Pydantic models for balances, quotes, orders, cancellations and trading rules, including Decimal and unknown-value semantics.
- [Korean cash-equity rules](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/en/api/rules/): Basic KRX cash-equity tick and regular-session helpers, trading-day callbacks and unsupported product scope.
- [Changelog](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/en/changelog/): Unreleased pykbroker 0.1.0 changes: broker adapters, safety primitives, MCP/CLI and remaining verification work.
- [Connect Korean brokerage tools to Claude Desktop](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/en/claude-desktop/): Connect pykbroker-mcp to Claude Desktop with JSON configuration, authentication environment injection, read-only checks and troubleshooting.
- [CLI](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/en/cli/): Read-only pykbroker CLI commands for quotes, balances, positions, order status and rules, with error exit-code behavior.
- [Contributing](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/en/contributing/): Contribute to pykbroker with safety-change reviews, offline tests and coordinated adapter documentation and license updates.
- [Execution SDK contract](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/en/execution-sdk-contract/): Fixed-context, quantity, quote, order, safety and HTTP contracts for engine implementers. pykbroker supplies no execution engine.
- [Getting started](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/en/getting-started/): Install pykbroker from source, prepare KIS/DB/Toss vendor SDKs, configure authentication environment variables and inject clients.
- [pykbroker](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/en/): pykbroker unifies KIS, DB Securities and Toss APIs in a Python SDK and read-only-by-default MCP server. Installation, support limits and safety.
- [MCP server](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/en/mcp/): Default query tools in pykbroker-mcp, limits.toml order-tool registration, dry-run blocking and SQLite ledger behavior.
- [Notice](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/en/notice/): pykbroker Apache-2.0 notice, extraction and rewriting attribution, referenced vendor revisions and separate license scope.
- [Safety primitives](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/en/safety/): Default order/cancellation blocking and injection contracts for caps, idempotency, kill switches and optional circuit breakers.
- [Security](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/en/security/): Environment-based credential injection, log masking, order-ledger preservation and private security reporting for pykbroker.
- [실행 SDK 계약](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/execution-sdk-contract/): 실행기 구현자를 위한 고정 컨텍스트·수량·시세·주문·안전·HTTP 계약. pykbroker는 실행 로직을 제공하지 않습니다.
- [Getting Started](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/getting-started/): pykbroker 소스 설치, KIS·DB·Toss 벤더 SDK 준비, 인증 환경변수와 클라이언트 주입 방법.
- [pykbroker](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/): 한국투자·DB증권·토스증권 Open API를 공통 Python SDK와 기본 읽기 전용 MCP 서버로 연결하는 pykbroker의 설치, 지원 범위와 안전장치.
- [MCP Server](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/mcp/): pykbroker-mcp의 기본 조회 도구, limits.toml 주문 도구 등록 조건, 드라이런 차단과 SQLite 원장 동작.
- [Notice](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/notice/): pykbroker의 Apache-2.0 고지, 추출·재작성 출처, 벤더 소스 리비전과 별도 라이선스 범위.
- [Safety primitives](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/safety/): 주문·취소 기본 차단, 한도·멱등성·킬스위치와 선택적 차단기 등 pykbroker 안전 부품의 주입 계약.
- [Security](https://stoa-company.github.io/pykbroker/security/): pykbroker 인증정보 환경 주입, 로그 마스킹, 주문 원장 보존과 비공개 보안 신고 안내.
